status: preregistered; full fits require explicit second-gate approval
replication_configuration: Exact original configuration; only declared seeds expand to 42/43/44. A/B/C seed 42 is prohibited by the extension entry point.

bpr.model: independent-domain matrix factorization; separate user and item tables per domain
bpr.initialization: independent Normal(0, 0.01) factors in frozen domain order
bpr.score: dot(p_user_domain, q_item_domain); no biases, sigmoid, MLP, sharing or graph
bpr.objective: mean(-logsigmoid(s_ui-s_uj)) + 0.5 * regularization * mean(||p_u||^2+||q_i||^2+||q_j||^2), over sampled triples
bpr.regularization_scope: sampled factors only, including repeated occurrences; not full-table L2
bpr.positive_sampling: Balanced domain cycling of shuffled TRAIN-interaction pools using existing batch_indices; 34 anchors/domain/update. Not uniform-user sampling.
bpr.negative_sampling: Existing complement-position-v1; uniform without replacement within each four-negative anchor group, excluding all known TRAIN positives only. No validation/test exclusion during training.
bpr.refresh: Ten windows matching original validation schedule; domain sampler seed = fit seed + one-based window + domain index; batch order seed = fit seed + window.
bpr.seed_behavior: torch.manual_seed(seed); CPU float32; one Torch thread; deterministic algorithms; seeded Python sampler
bpr.exposure_caveat: 102 anchors/update vs 102.4 expected positive BCE examples/update at ratio 1:4. Approximately matched, not identical positive or optimizer streams. BPR anchors carry all four negatives together.
bpr.configuration_selection: One fixed preregistered configuration; no pilot tuning, no hyperparameter search, no test-based adjustment. Adam/minibatching and sampled L2 adapt the BPR objective, not the paper's exact experimental setup.
bpr.reference: Rendle et al., BPR: Bayesian Personalized Ranking from Implicit Feedback, UAI 2009; https://arxiv.org/abs/1205.2618

checkpoint_rule: maximum macro validation nDCG@10; earliest exact tie; no early stopping
evaluator: Unmodified final_study.evaluate and frozen prepared queries: full TRAIN catalog, frozen chronological exclusions and ties, warm users/items, P/R/nDCG@10; queries averaged within user, users within domain, then equal-weight domain macro.
test_gate: No TEST scoring in this phase or fit entry point. All nine fits and selected checkpoints must be complete and frozen before separate once-per-checkpoint TEST evaluation. Original seed-42 outputs are reused, not regenerated.
matched_stream_gate: For each new seed require A sampling_sha256 == B sampling_sha256 == C sampling_sha256 before TEST. BPR uses grouped int64 triples; its hash is recorded but must not be equated with NeuMF's float32 BCE stream hash.
failure_policy: Stop on numerical/hardware/memory failure. Preserve partial run directory; no automatic retry, seed replacement or additional fit. Warn above 6 GiB; stop above 10 GiB; one process/model at a time.
outputs: New tracked training/freeze/test/summary artifacts only under research/results/controlled_extension; checkpoints and protocol/result snapshots under ignored research/runs/controlled_extension. Never overwrite original results.

reporting.aggregates: Each seed, mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=1) for A/B/C/BPR; B-A and C-A seed-matched differences; BPR versus A and fixed Most Popular. Frozen warm/cold coverage accompanies every comparison.
reporting.uncertainty: Three seeds are descriptive training-randomness evidence, not conclusive significance. Paired-user bootstrap uses existing implementation and is conditional on fitted seed, not training-seed uncertainty. Historical V2 is separate; D/D_FIXED remain seed-42-only.
reporting.interpretation: Report every authorized fit; direct comparison only within ContextFit protocol, contextual comparison to paper metrics. Existing seed-42 conclusion and files remain canonical original evidence. Extension results may support or complicate it. No predetermined winner.
